name: POET / Enhanced POET (Paired Open-Ended Trailblazer)
description: POET is a 2D physics-based obstacle-course framework where environments (terrains with varying obstacles, gaps, roughness, etc.) procedurally co-evolve with agent populations. The system endlessly invents novel, increasingly complex challenges while agents solve them and transfer knowledge across environments via goal-switching to avoid local optima. Enhanced POET extends the original with improved novelty metrics and transfer heuristics, enabling unbounded open-ended skill discovery.
reputation: Landmark open-ended RL framework; coined the paired co-evolution approach; widely cited in open-endedness and continual learning research.
notes: Primarily an RL/evolutionary benchmark; not natively human-playable but simulation interfaces can be added. Co-evolution means both agent and environment improve together, preventing saturation. Not a static dataset — difficulty is unbounded.
